## Goal
ROADMAP 0.4 order item 3 and 3.5: a one-page printable "what we did for you" report. In-house builds the page; this WO builds the numbers and the sentences behind it, so layout never has to decide wording. Add to `exposure_models.py` a pydantic `ReportFacts` (all counts and dates, no names, no URLs, no site names) and two pure functions: `report_facts(first, latest, activity) -> ReportFacts` and `report_lines(facts) -> list[str]`. `first` and `latest` are `ExposureResult | None` (the earliest and the newest fresh scan; `exposure_models.py:144-178`); `activity` is a plain dict of counts the caller supplies (`requests_sent`, `confirmed`, `relisted`, `waiting`, `needs_you`) so this module never reads a store. The facts say whether the two scans are `comparable` (same `score_version`, and the later one checked at least as many sites), because `trend_note` already refuses to claim progress otherwise (`engine/exposure.py:846-865`).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `report_facts(None, None, {...})` returns a valid object with `scans == 0`; `report_lines` for it says no check has been run yet, in one sentence, and does not mention a score.
2. One scan: facts have `first_scan_date == last_scan_date`, `score_change is None`, `comparable is False`; lines do not claim a change.
3. Two scans, same version, later one checked as many or more sites: `comparable True`, `score_change` is latest minus first, and the line says "went down 12 points since 2026-01-05" style wording (singular for 1 point, same words as `trend_note`).
4. Different `score_version`, or fewer sites checked: `comparable False` and the lines say the two numbers cannot be compared (no change claimed).
5. Practice mode: if the latest scan has `practice_mode True`, the lines say "Practice mode is on: no requests have gone out yet" and never say requests were sent, even if `activity["requests_sent"]` is non-zero (those are practice requests).
6. Every sentence is under 25 words, uses "requested" / "confirmed" / "came back" (never "erased", "guarantee", "100%", "safe"), and the report always includes the coverage note (`coverage_note`, `exposure_models.py:98-116`) when a scan exists.
7. Singular/plural table for 0, 1, 2 of every count; counts that are negative or not ints are clamped to 0 (never raise).
8. No field or line contains a broker name, URL, listing value or profile value (sentinel test with fake entries).
9. Existing exposure_models, coverage and trend tests pass unchanged; `ExposureResult` and stored events are unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
